items.title: Introduction
items.body: Status: approved · Revision: 8 · Describes `main` (CR-2, CR-3, CR-8, CR-9, CR-10, CR-13 and CR-22 folded)

items.title: Contract (`src/contract.ts`)
items.body:
- Responsibility: the shape of everything exchanged; validation with field paths.
- Data model: `ReviewDoc` (zod), `Item`, `Choice`, `Feedback`, `Comment` (`item`, `line >= 0`,   optional `range {start, end, quote}`, `body` or `suggestion`), `Range`.
- Interface: `validateReview(input)`, `validateFeedback(input, doc?)` return `{ok, value}` or   `{ok: false, errors: [{path, message}]}`; `itemLines(item)` gives an item's lines (non-empty body   lines, then question choices as `a) label`, then `Check: …`); `anchorText(doc, item, line)`;   `scopeOf(anchor)` and `inScope(scope, target)`; `DOC` is reserved.
- Errors: duplicate IDs, questions without choices, unknown dependencies, anchors that don't exist,   a range whose quote doesn't match.

items.title: Edit engine (`src/edit.ts`)
items.body:
- Responsibility: change exactly one span in exactly one field.
- Interface: `locate(doc, {item, line, find, replace, start?})` (at `start`, or the single   occurrence); `applyEdit(doc, edit)` returns a new document; `wordStats(find, replace, line)`;   `narrow(text, replacement)` shrinks a whole-line suggestion to the differing words.
- Behavior: `setter` maps an anchor to its field (title, TL;DR, heading, the n-th non-empty body line   keeping its indentation, a choice's label, the check); the result is re-read and compared.
- Errors (`EditError` with a field): not found, ambiguous, line breaks in `replace`, emptying a line,   editing an option's letter, changing a document line's markdown block markers, editing a TL;DR   copied from the first paragraph.

items.title: Markdown (`src/markdown.ts`)
items.body:
- Interface: `parseMarkdown(md, {title, tldr, slug, channel, review_id})`, `exportMarkdown(doc)`,   `keepIds(prior, next)`, `JOIN` (U+2028).
- Behavior: first `#` heading is the title; ATX and setext headings start sections (`level`);   blocks are paragraphs, list items with continuations, quote lines, table rows, fenced and indented   code, thematic breaks, each one line with source lines joined by U+2028; blank lines between   blocks and around headings kept as empty body lines (not commentable, so anchors don't move);   intro is section `S-0` at level 0; TL;DR defaults to the first paragraph (`tldr_auto`). With   `spacing: "exact"` (a document with a `#` title), export writes headings and bodies verbatim;   without it, one blank line around headings.

items.title: Store (`src/store.ts`)
items.body:
- Data model: `ReviewMeta` (id, slug, title, channel, status open/approved/closed, revisions,   repo_dir, github PrRef, supersedes, decision_files, pr_answers), `Reply`, `Proposal` (id, thread,   revision, item, line, find, replace, start, line_text, words, status), `Applied`.
- Interface: `create`, `addRevision`, `update`, `meta`, `revision`, `feedback`, `allFeedback`,   `addFeedback` (assigns `th_<review>_<n>` thread IDs), `setFeedback`, `replies`, `addReply`,   `proposals`, `writeProposals`, `applied`, `addApplied`, `findThread`, `list`.
- Behavior: atomic writes (temp file and rename); review IDs validated before building paths.

items.title: Core (`src/hoop.ts`)
items.body:
- Interface: `submit`, `submitAny` (GitHub channel), `feedback`, `feedbackAny` (refreshes GitHub),   `review` (validates new comments against the current revision; replies keep their anchor),   `applySuggestion`, `proposeEdits`, `editPosition`, `decideEdit`, `reply`, `replyAny`, `refresh`,   `writeDecision`.
- Behavior: documents keep section IDs across revisions (`keepIds`); approval freezes and writes   decisions (clean markdown for `kind: "doc"`); accepted spans rebase other proposals on the line;   every action is audited.
- Errors: `HoopError(message, fieldErrors)`; approved, closed and GitHub reviews refuse local edits.
- Since CR-8, `applySuggestion`, `proposeEdits`, `editPosition` and `decideEdit` delegate to the   materializer, and every refusal comes from the review rules.

items.title: Review rules (`src/rules.ts`, CR-8)
items.body:
- `editable(store, id, { open, frozen, github })` returns the review or throws. Each caller passes   its own wording for a GitHub review. `thread(store, id, threadId)` returns the first comment, its   revision and every entry. `threadIds` and `existing` sit alongside them.
- `reviewStatus(store, meta)` gives a review's status key (CR-9). The keys are awaiting_review,   commented, changes_requested, approved and closed. A GitHub review that is approved but not   merged is awaiting_review, with a note.

items.title: Materializer (`src/materialize.ts`, CR-8)
items.body: - The `Materializer` holds apply, propose, decide, edit positions and the rebase of other proposals   on a line. It uses the review rules, the edit engine and the store.

items.title: GitHub (`src/github.ts`)
items.body:
- Interface: `GitHub(gh)` with `open(dir, doc)`, `revise(ref, doc, n)`, `sync(ref, id, revisions)`,   `reply(ref, rootCommentId, body)`; `PrRef` keeps `commits` (sha to revision) and `own_comments`.
- Behavior: commits through the git trees API (the checkout is untouched); maps comment lines through   the rendered line map of the revision they were made on; resolved threads via GraphQL.

items.title: MCP, web, wait, audit, CLI
items.body:
- `src/mcp.ts`: six tools; `failure()` returns errors as tool errors and audits them.
- `src/web.ts`: route table behind Host, Origin and JSON checks; `reviewView` adds item lines,   history per revision, replies, applied edits and proposal positions. `web/app.js` renders;   `review.js` adds comments, threads, Apply, tracked-change cards and Finish; `select.js` handles   selection (ignoring inserted text) and decorations.
- `src/wait.ts`: polls the store (and GitHub every 15 s) until a new review, approval or close.
- `src/audit.ts`: `audit(event, data)` appends; `readAudit`, `summarize` for `hoop audit`.

items.title: Pages and line rendering (`web/*`, CR-9)
items.body:
- `web/blocks.js` holds the line rules. `blockKinds(rawLines)` gives each body line a block,   `{ kind, indent }`. The kinds are paragraph, list, quote, code, break and table, and a kind the   pages don't know shows as written. It replays the parser's open block between lines.   `pieceMarker(piece)` gives the structure markers that an edit must keep. The parser, `itemBlocks` in `src/contract.ts` and the edit engine   import it, and so do the pages.
- `web/inline.js` renders a line. `renderLine(text, decorations, block)` puts every shown source   character in a span that records its offset. `widen` grows a selection to whole formatted runs,   `findTyped` matches typed words in the shown text, and `sourceOffset` maps a DOM position back.   Only escaped text and a fixed set of tags reach the page, and links open only http and https.
- `web/frame.js`, `web/status.js`, `web/icons.js` and `web/esc.js` hold the frame, the status   labels, the icons and escaping.
- API: each review in `GET /api/reviews` and the view in `GET /api/reviews/<id>` gain   `status_key`, `status_note` when there is one, and `repo`, which is `{ name, key }`. Neither   response carries a folder path. Each item gains `blocks`, the view gains `history_blocks`, and   `GET /api/info` gives the served folder's identity. `repoIdentity` in `src/util.ts` builds it.   For FR-53, `GET /api/info` lists the open repositories instead, as the next section says.
- Tests: `test/pages.test.ts` checks every page in both themes, at 400 pixels, from the keyboard,   offline and with `axe-core`. `HOOP_REQUIRE_BROWSER=1` turns a skipped browser into a failure.

items.title: Document checks (`src/checks.ts`, `web/checks.js`, CR-10)
items.body:
- `runCheck(repo, markdown, home)` returns an outcome   `{ ran, reason?, message?, command?, allow?, findings, ms?, started? }`, or nothing when the   repository sets no command. A finding is `{ line?, message, place? }`, and a place is   `{ item, line }`.
- Configs: `hoop.config.json` holds `{ "check": [arguments] }`. The hoop folder's `config.json`   holds `{ "checks": [{ "repo", "command" }] }`. An entry matches an absolute folder, by real path,   with the same argument list.
- It writes the document to a temporary file and runs the command with that path as the last   argument. It uses `spawn` with no shell, in the repository folder. After ten seconds it stops the   process group. It never throws.
- Reasons are `not_allowed`, `failed`, `timeout`, `running` and `stopped`. A `not_allowed` outcome   holds the allow entry for the agent.
- `linePlaces(markdown, options)` in `src/markdown.ts` maps each source line to an item's position   and its `itemLines` line, both from 0. The core maps the position to the stored revision's ID.
- `submitAny(input, { source })` takes `source`, which is `{ markdown, options }`, from the   `submit_markdown` operation. The core stores a `running` outcome, then the final one, with the   store's `saveCheck`, in `checks-<revision>.json`. It audits only the final one. `latestCheck`   finds the newest stored outcome. `hoop audit` counts checks run, findings and checks that didn't   run.
- The `hoop_submit_markdown` description says the result may hold `checks`, and the interface   snapshot was updated for it.
- The view's `checks` drops the allow entry and shows a fixed message for each reason. A `running`   outcome older than the timeout reads as `stopped`.
- `web/checks.js` renders the panel. `goToLine` in `web/app.js` jumps to a finding's line. It opens   a collapsed item, switches a tracker table to its lines, and moves focus to the line. A finding   from an older revision shows that revision's line and offers no jump.
- This repository runs `scripts/check-writing.sh`, which runs devloop's writing checker.

items.title: Conversations and hidden comments (`web/review.js`, CR-13)
items.body:
- A resolved conversation renders as a `details` element with a summary row. `state.openThreads`   keeps the ones the reviewer opened, through a `toggle` listener that captures the event.
- A local thread is resolved while no entry is newer than the review that resolved it. A GitHub   thread follows the sync's resolved list. That list comes from the latest review on the latest   revision, so after a newer revision with no review, GitHub threads show in full.
- `state.commentsHidden` sets a `comments-hidden` class on the page root on every render.   `data-comment="hide"` elements disappear in that mode, and `data-comment="plain"` elements keep   their words without styling. `web/inline.js` marks highlights and Claude's struck text `plain`,   and Claude's inserted text `hide`. Any later renderer follows the same rule. It marks `hide` on what   only shows a comment, and `plain` on what wraps the document's own words. The hide control isn't offered while the comment box or the finish   panel is open, and opening either one ends the mode.

items.title: Pages process (`src/pages.ts`, `src/sessions.ts`, `src/version.ts`, FR-48 to FR-57)
items.body:
- `src/version.ts`: `release(install)` reads an install's `package.json`. `codeId(install)` hashes   the path, size and modified time of each file under `src/`, `dist/` and `web/`, without reading   contents. Releases compare as dotted numbers, and one that doesn't parse is never newer.
- `src/sessions.ts`: each `hoop mcp` session writes `sessions/<pid>.json` in the store's folder.   The entry holds a format version, start and boot times, the repository, install, release and   start command. `liveSessions(home)` keeps an entry only when it is a small file the user owns.   Its process must run with the same start time, read from one `ps` call.
- `src/pages.ts`, the starter: `ensurePages(home)` asks `GET /api/info` with a one second deadline.   It reuses hoop for the same store, and starts `hoop serve` with `HOOP_PAGES=background`,   detached, when nothing answers. Anything else leaves the tools working. `HOOP_PAGES=off` skips it.
- The pages process binds the usual address, retrying for five seconds. Every two seconds, its own   timer picks a restart target. That is the newest release a live session's install holds on disk,   when it differs from its own. Otherwise it is its own install, when its files changed. It hands the address to the   target and exits once that answers. Otherwise it stops the target, binds again, and reports   `stale`. It tries each target once, and exits when its install is gone on two checks.
- It exits after `HOOP_PAGES_IDLE_MS` (an hour) with no live session and no same-site request.   Each open page asks `GET /api/info` every minute, so an open page counts as use.
- The server reads the open repositories again when the sessions folder changes, or after ten   seconds. An unknown key reads them at most once a second. It serves the page files it read at start.
- Pages: `web/index.html` loads the app through a dynamic import, and shows the error and the   restart step when nothing starts in five seconds. The frame shows the release and a short code   ID. `#banner` warns while `stale` is true, or when the info request fails twice. The tracker page   keeps `repo=<key>` in its address.
- Audit: `pages_start`, `pages_restart`, `pages_fallback`, `pages_stop`, `pages_not_started` and   `pages_start_failed`.

items.title: Change registry (`src/changes.ts`, CR-3)
items.body:
- Data model: `docs/changes/CR-<n>-<slug>/REQUEST.md` (the request, byte for byte, written once)   and `change.json` `{ id, slug, title, type, reason, created, steps: [{step, at, by}], reviews:   {prd?, hld?, lld?: string[]}, prs: number[] }`. `steps` is append-only; the last is current.
- Interface: `create(text, {type, reason, title?, slug?, by?})` reserves the next number with an   exclusive folder create; `classify(cr, type, reason, {why?})` logs a corrected type to   `CLASSIFICATION.md` before saving; `moveStep(cr, step)` allows only the next step or `closed`,   asks the gate hook, and for fold checks every linked PR with `gh pr view` (injectable);   `linkPr`, `addReview`, `get`, `list`. Folders without `change.json` read as type `unknown`.

items.title: Review sequencer (`src/sequence.ts`, CR-3)
items.body:
- A review is linked to `{cr, doc, repo}` in `ReviewMeta.change`; a revision inherits the link and   can't be relinked. `approved_at` is set on approval (the merge time on GitHub).
- `state(cr)`: each document's current review, status, approval time and staleness (stale when   the document before isn't approved, is stale, or was approved later). `blockers(cr, doc)` before   a review opens; `ready(cr)` for build. `gatedChanges(store, repo)` wires the build gate and keeps   the change's row in `docs/TRACKER.md` (failures are audited, not thrown).

items.title: Tracker service (`src/tracker.ts`, CR-3)
items.body: - The first table whose header has ID and Parent; columns by name. `readTracker(path)` gives   `{columns, items, tree, hash}`; `setCells` and `addItem` rewrite only their row (a missing column   is added on every row), keep each line's ending, refuse a stale `base` hash, and write   atomically through symlinks. `trackerTables(lines)` serves review pages; `insideRepo` confines   paths to the repository.

items.title: Operations and CLI (`src/ops.ts`, `src/cli.ts`, CR-3)
items.body: - `OPS`: `{name, title, description, input (zod), run(hoop, input, {actor}), cli: {command, usage,   parse}, link?}`. For FR-49, `link: true` marks an operation whose result holds a link, so the   MCP server and the CLI call `ensurePages` before it. MCP registers `hoop_<name>`; the CLI matches the longest command words, takes the   `--name <value>` flags in the usage line (unknown flags refused), validates with the same schema,   prints text or `--json`, and exits 1 with field errors. The CLI acts on the git repository root.

items.title: Tracker pages (`web/tree.js`, `web/tracker.js`, CR-3)
items.body: - `renderTree(key, columns, rows)`: depth-first rows with carets, type badges, status and phase   chips, filters that keep ancestors; rows with comments or edits stay visible. Review pages render   each item's `tables` (from the API) as trees with each row's line anchor and threads.
